entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Qing Empire, a political institution in Hong Kong during Early European Contact and Qing Hong Kong (1839–1842). Grew from Treaty of Nanjing — Hong Kong Island ceded to Britain 'in perpetuity' and Canton Trade System. Led to the emergence of Treaty of Nanjing and British forces occupy Hong Kong Island.
